# unicode_plot.cr

[![Test](https://github.com/kojix2/unicode_plot/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kojix2/unicode_plot/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![Lines of Code](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftokei.kojix2.net%2Fbadge%2Fgithub%2Fkojix2%2Funicode_plot%2Flines)](https://tokei.kojix2.net/github/kojix2/unicode_plot)

Unicode terminal plots for Crystal, ported from Julia's [UnicodePlots.jl](https://github.com/JuliaPlots/UnicodePlots.jl).

🚧 **UNDER CONSTRUCTION** 🚧

- Before the first release, history may be rewritten (force-push).
- API and behavior are still being aligned with UnicodePlots.jl.

## Current coverage

Implemented plot interfaces:

- `lineplot`, `lineplot!`
- `scatterplot`, `scatterplot!`
- `barplot`
- `histogram`
- `boxplot`
- `densityplot`, `densityplot!`
- `heatmap`
- `spy`
- `polarplot`, `polarplot!`
- `stairs`, `stairs!`
- `contourplot`, `contourplot!` (experimental)

See [examples/](examples/) for runnable scripts.

- Contour example: [examples/contourplot.cr](examples/contourplot.cr)

## Installation

Add to your `shard.yml`:

```yaml
dependencies:
  unicode_plot:
    github: kojix2/unicode_plot.cr
```

Then run `shards install`.

## Quick start

```crystal
require "unicode_plot"
include UnicodePlot
```

### Line plot

```crystal
x = (0..62).map { |i| i * Math::PI / 31.0 }
y = x.map { |v| Math.sin(v) }
puts lineplot(x, y, title: "sin(x)", xlabel: "x", ylabel: "sin(x)", color: :blue)
```

### Scatter plot

```crystal
x1 = (1..15).map { Random.rand * 3.0 + 1.0 }
y1 = (1..15).map { Random.rand * 3.0 + 1.0 }
x2 = (1..15).map { Random.rand * 3.0 + 6.0 }
y2 = (1..15).map { Random.rand * 3.0 + 6.0 }

p = scatterplot(x1, y1, name: "cluster A", color: :blue,
  title: "Two clusters", xlim: {0.0, 11.0}, ylim: {0.0, 11.0})
scatterplot!(p, x2, y2, name: "cluster B", color: :red)
puts p
```

### Polar plot

```crystal
theta = (0...40).map { |i| 4.0 * Math::PI * i.to_f64 / 39.0 }
r = theta.map { |angle| angle / (2.0 * Math::PI) }
puts polarplot(theta, r, title: "Polar line", color: :green)
```

### Bar plot

```crystal
cities  = ["Tokyo", "Delhi", "Shanghai", "São Paulo", "Mexico City"]
popmill = [13.96, 16.79, 24.18, 12.33, 9.21]
puts barplot(cities, popmill, title: "City populations", xlabel: "population [mil]")
```

You can also pass a `Hash(String, Float64)` directly (sorted by key):

```crystal
puts barplot({"Ruby" => 95.0, "Python" => 98.0, "Crystal" => 72.0}, title: "Scores")
```

### Histogram

```crystal
data = (1..500).map { Random.rand * 10.0 }
puts histogram(data, title: "Uniform [0, 10)", nbins: 15)
```

### Add series incrementally (`!` variants)

Most series-based plot types support a mutating `!` variant:

```crystal
x = (1..20).map(&.to_f)
p = lineplot(x, x.map { |v| Math.sqrt(v) }, name: "√x", color: :green, title: "Functions")
lineplot!(p, x, x.map { |v| Math.log(v) }, name: "ln(x)", color: :red)
puts p
```

### Time x-axis (experimental)

`lineplot` and `stairs` can accept `Array(Time)` for the x-axis. This API is experimental and currently requires an explicit Crystal `Time#to_s` format string:

```crystal
dates = (0..10).map { |i| Time.utc(2020, 1, 1) + i.days }
puts lineplot(dates, dates.map_with_index { |_, i| i.to_f }, format: "%F")
```

### Options

| Option              | Description                                                                             |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`             | Plot title                                                                              |
| `xlabel` / `ylabel` | Axis labels                                                                             |
| `xlim` / `ylim`     | Axis limits as `{min, max}` tuple                                                       |
| `color`             | Line/point color (`:red`, `:blue`, `:green`, `:cyan`, `:magenta`, `:yellow`, `:normal`) |
| `name`              | Series name (shown in legend)                                                           |
| `xscale` / `yscale` | Scale function (`:log2`, `:log10`, or a `Proc(Float64, Float64)`)                       |
| `width` / `height`  | Canvas size in characters                                                               |
| `canvas`            | Canvas type (`:braille`, `:block`, `:ascii`)                                            |

## Practical notes

- This project prioritizes Julia compatibility in visible output.
- Some interfaces may still differ while ports are in progress.
- `spec/reference_spec.cr` compares output against Julia reference assets.

## Development

Run specs from repository root:

```bash
crystal spec
```

Reference fixtures are stored under [spec/fixtures/](spec/fixtures/).

constants.name: ASCII_DECODE_512
constants.value:
begin
  table = Array(Char).new(512, ' ')

  sorted_lookup = ASCII_LOOKUP_MAP.to_a.sort_by do |k, _v| k end
  (0_u32...512_u32).each do |pattern|
    if pattern == 0
      table[pattern] = ' '
    elsif ASCII_LOOKUP_MAP.has_key?(pattern)
      table[pattern] = ASCII_LOOKUP_MAP[pattern]
    else
      best_char = ' '
      best_dist = Int32::MAX
      sorted_lookup.each do |__temp_76|
        k, v = __temp_76
        dist = 0
        x = pattern ^ k
        while x != 0
          if (x & 1) != 0
            dist = dist + 1
          end
          x = x >> 1
        end
        if dist < best_dist
          best_dist = dist
          best_char = v
        end
      end
      table[pattern] = best_char
    end
  end
  table
end

Full 512-entry decode table built at startup.
For unmapped patterns, the closest entry by Hamming distance is used.

def.name: ansi_bg_escape
def.body:
if color == INVALID_COLOR
  return ""
end
if color < THRESHOLD
  "\e[48;2;#{red(color)};#{grn(color)};#{blu(color)}m"
else
  "\e[48;5;#{(color - THRESHOLD).to_u8}m"
end

def.name: barplot

args.name: color
args.restriction: Symbol | Int32 | ::Tuple(Int32, Int32, Int32) | Array(Symbol) | Array(Int32) | Array(UInt32) | UInt32

def.body:
if text.size == heights.size
else
  raise(ArgumentError.new("text and heights must have the same length"))
end
if heights.all? do |val| val >= 0 end
else
  raise(ArgumentError.new("all values must be >= 0"))
end

final_text, final_heights, spacers, source_rows = normalize_bar_rows(text, heights)
expanded_color = case color
when Array(Symbol)
  if color.size == heights.size
  else
    raise(ArgumentError.new("colors must match bars"))
  end
  source_rows.map do |i| (color.as(Array(Symbol)))[i] end
when Array(Int32)
  if color.size == heights.size
  else
    raise(ArgumentError.new("colors must match bars"))
  end
  source_rows.map do |i| (color.as(Array(Int32)))[i] end
when Array(UInt32)
  if color.size == heights.size
  else
    raise(ArgumentError.new("colors must match bars"))
  end
  source_rows.map do |i| (color.as(Array(UInt32)))[i] end
else
  color
end

char_width = width || default_width
fmt = if integer_labels
  ->(x : Float64) do
    (x.finite? && x >= Int64::MIN.to_f) && x < Int64::MAX.to_f ? nice_repr(x.round.to_i64, unicode_exponent, thousands_separator) : nice_repr(x, unicode_exponent, thousands_separator)
  end
else
  ->(x : Float64) do
    bar_float_label(x, unicode_exponent, thousands_separator)
  end
end
area = BarplotGraphics.new(final_heights, char_width, symbols: symbols, color: expanded_color, maximum: maximum, formatter: fmt, xscale: xscale, spacer_rows: spacers)

xlab = xlabel.empty? ? transform_name(xscale, xlabel) : xlabel
plot = Plot.new(area, border: border, title: title, xlabel: xlab, margin: margin, padding: padding, labels: labels, compact_labels: compact_labels, compact: compact, unicode_exponent: unicode_exponent, thousands_separator: thousands_separator)

if name.empty?
else
  plot.label!(:r, name, suitable_color(area, color))
end

final_text.each_with_index do |label, i|
  plot.label!(:l, i + 1, label)
end

plot

instance_methods.name: blend_colors
instance_methods.doc: Blend two ColorType values
instance_methods.args_string: (a : UInt32, b : UInt32) : UInt32
instance_methods.args_html: (a : UInt32, b : UInt32) : UInt32

def.name: blend_colors
def.body:
if a == b
  return a
end
if a < THRESHOLD && b < THRESHOLD
  r = (Math.sqrt((((red(a)).to_u32 ** 2) + ((red(b)).to_u32 ** 2)) / 2.0)).floor.to_u32
  g = (Math.sqrt((((grn(a)).to_u32 ** 2) + ((grn(b)).to_u32 ** 2)) / 2.0)).floor.to_u32
  bl = (Math.sqrt((((blu(a)).to_u32 ** 2) + ((blu(b)).to_u32 ** 2)) / 2.0)).floor.to_u32
  ((r32(r)) + (g32(g))) + (b32(bl))
elsif ((a >= THRESHOLD && a < INVALID_COLOR) && b >= THRESHOLD) && b < INVALID_COLOR
  THRESHOLD + ((a - THRESHOLD).to_u8 | (b - THRESHOLD).to_u8).to_u32
elsif (a != INVALID_COLOR) && (b != INVALID_COLOR)
  Math.max(a, b)
else
  INVALID_COLOR
end

def.body:
if data.empty?
  raise(ArgumentError.new("data is empty"))
end

if xlim != {0.0, 0.0}
  xmin, xmax = xlim
else
  all_vals = data.flatten
  xmin, xmax = extend_limits(all_vals, {0.0, 0.0})
end
char_width = width || default_width

def.body:
mx, bx = extend_limits(x, xlim, xscale)
my, by = extend_limits(y, ylim, yscale)
raw_xmin, raw_xmax = raw_axis_limits(x, xlim, xscale, {mx, bx})
raw_ymin, raw_ymax = raw_axis_limits(y, ylim, yscale, {my, by})

w = (width || default_width).clamp(min_width, Int32::MAX)

can = case canvas_type
when :braille
  BrailleCanvas.new(h, w, origin_y: my, origin_x: mx, height: by - my, width: bx - mx, blend: blend, visible: (w >= 0), yflip: yflip, xflip: xflip, yscale: yscale.is_a?(Symbol) ? yscale.as(Symbol) : yscale.as(Proc(Float64, Float64)), xscale: xscale.is_a?(Symbol) ? xscale.as(Symbol) : xscale.as(Proc(Float64, Float64)))
when :block
  BlockCanvas.new(h, w, origin_y: my, origin_x: mx, height: by - my, width: bx - mx, blend: blend, visible: (w >= 0), yflip: yflip, xflip: xflip, yscale: yscale.is_a?(Symbol) ? yscale.as(Symbol) : yscale.as(Proc(Float64, Float64)), xscale: xscale.is_a?(Symbol) ? xscale.as(Symbol) : xscale.as(Proc(Float64, Float64)))
when :ascii

else

end

plot = Plot.new(can, title: title, xlabel: xlabel, ylabel: ylabel, margin: margin, padding: padding, border: border, compact_labels: compact_labels, compact: compact, labels: labels, colorbar: colorbar, colorbar_border: colorbar_border, colorbar_lim: colorbar_lim, unicode_exponent: unicode_exponent, thousands_separator: thousands_separator)
plot.raw_xlim = {raw_xmin, raw_xmax}
plot.raw_ylim = {raw_ymin, raw_ymax}

bc = ansi_color(border_color)
if xticks
  m_x = nice_repr(mx, unicode_exponent, thousands_separator)
  b_x = nice_repr(bx, unicode_exponent, thousands_separator)
  base_x = xscale.is_a?(Symbol) ? BASES[xscale.as(Symbol)]? : nil
  if base_x
    pfx = base_x + (unicode_exponent ? "" : "^")
    m_x = pfx + (unicode_exponent ? superscript(m_x) : m_x)
    b_x = pfx + (unicode_exponent ? superscript(b_x) : b_x)
  end
  plot.label!(:bl, xflip ? b_x : m_x, bc)
  plot.label!(:br, xflip ? m_x : b_x, bc)
end
if yticks
  m_y = nice_repr(my, unicode_exponent, thousands_separator)
  b_y = nice_repr(by, unicode_exponent, thousands_separator)
  base_y = yscale.is_a?(Symbol) ? BASES[yscale.as(Symbol)]? : nil

    m_y = pfx + (unicode_exponent ? superscript(m_y) : m_y)
    b_y = pfx + (unicode_exponent ? superscript(b_y) : b_y)
  end
  plot.label!(:l, can.nrows, yflip ? b_y : m_y, bc)
  plot.label!(:l, 1, yflip ? m_y : b_y, bc)
end

if grid
  if raw_ymin < 0.0 && raw_ymax > 0.0
    can.lines!(raw_xmin, 0.0, raw_xmax, 0.0, ansi_color(border_color), true)
  end
  if raw_xmin < 0.0 && raw_xmax > 0.0
    can.lines!(0.0, raw_ymin, 0.0, raw_ymax, ansi_color(border_color), true)
  end
end

def.name: colormap_callback
def.body:
stops = COLORMAP_STOPS[name]? || (raise(ArgumentError.new("unknown colormap: #{name}")))
->(z : Float64, zmin : Float64, zmax : Float64) do
  if z.finite?
  else
    return INVALID_COLOR
  end
  t = zmax > zmin ? ((z - zmin) / (zmax - zmin)).clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 0.5
  i = 0
  while i < (stops.size - 2) && stops[i + 1][0] <= t
    i = i + 1
  end
  s0 = stops[i]
  s1 = stops[i + 1]
  alpha = s1[0] > s0[0] ? (t - s0[0]) / (s1[0] - s0[0]) : 0.0
  r = (s0[1] + (alpha * (s1[1] - s0[1]))).round.to_i32
  g = (s0[2] + (alpha * (s1[2] - s0[2]))).round.to_i32
  b = (s0[3] + (alpha * (s1[3] - s0[3]))).round.to_i32
  UnicodePlot.ansi_color(r, g, b)
end

def.name: extend_limits
def.body:
mi, ma = lims[0], lims[1]
explicit = !((mi == 0.0) && (ma == 0.0))
fn = scale_callback(scale)
values = if explicit
  lower = fn.call(mi)
  upper = fn.call(ma)
  if (lower.finite? && upper.finite?) && lower <= upper
  else
    raise(ArgumentError.new("axis limits must be finite and increasing after scaling"))
  end
  [lower, upper]
else
  vec.compact_map do |v| if v.finite?
    fn.call(v)
  end end.select(&.finite?).to_a
end
if values.empty?
  return {-1.0, 1.0}
end
mi, ma = values.min, values.max
if mi == ma
  mi, ma = expand_equal_limits(mi)
end
if scale == (:identity)
  explicit ? {mi, ma} : plotting_range_narrow(mi, ma)
else
  {mi, ma}
end

def.name: heatmap
def.body:
matrix = MatrixView.new(z)

data_nrows = matrix.nrows
data_ncols = matrix.ncols


y_arr = matrix_axis_coords(data_nrows, yfact, yoffset)
x_arr = matrix_axis_coords(data_ncols, xfact, xoffset)


eff_ylim = if ylim == {0.0, 0.0}
  y_arr.empty? ? {0.0, 0.0} : {y_arr.min, y_arr.max}
else
  {ylim[0].to_f, ylim[1].to_f}
end
eff_xlim = if xlim == {0.0, 0.0}
  x_arr.empty? ? {0.0, 0.0} : {x_arr.min, x_arr.max}
else
  {xlim[0].to_f, xlim[1].to_f}
end


y_first = y_arr.index do |v| v >= eff_ylim[0] end
y_last = y_arr.rindex do |v| v <= eff_ylim[1] end
x_first = x_arr.index do |v| v >= eff_xlim[0] end
x_last = x_arr.rindex do |v| v <= eff_xlim[1] end

y_sub = if (y_first && y_last) && y_first <= y_last
  y_arr[y_first..y_last]
else
  [] of Float64
end
x_sub = if (x_first && x_last) && x_first <= x_last
  x_arr[x_first..x_last]
else
  [] of Float64
end
z_sub = if ((((y_first && y_last) && x_first) && x_last) && y_first <= y_last) && x_first <= x_last
  z[y_first..y_last].map do |row| row[x_first..x_last] end
else
  [] of Array(Float64)
end


eff_yfact = yfact || 1.0
eff_xfact = xfact || 1.0
dy = eff_ylim[1] - eff_ylim[0]
dx = eff_xlim[1] - eff_xlim[0]
size_nrows = if (dy == 0.0) || dy < 0.0
  y_sub.size.clamp(1, Int32::MAX)
else
  ((dy / eff_yfact).ceil.to_i32 + 1).clamp(1, Int32::MAX)
end
size_ncols = if (dx == 0.0) || dx < 0.0
  x_sub.size.clamp(1, Int32::MAX)
else
  ((dx / eff_xfact).ceil.to_i32 + 1).clamp(1, Int32::MAX)
end


data_ar = size_ncols.to_f / size_nrows.to_f
max_height_in = if height
  height
elsif width
  (width.to_f / data_ar).ceil.to_i32
else
  0
end
max_width_in = if width
  width
elsif height
  (height.to_f * data_ar).ceil.to_i32
else
  0
end

char_height, char_width = heatmap_dimensions(size_nrows, size_ncols, max_height_in, max_width_in, height, width, margin, padding, fix_ar, out_stream)


submatrix = MatrixView.new(z_sub)
has_extrema = false
zmin, zmax = if zlim != {0.0, 0.0}
  has_extrema = true
  {zlim[0], zlim[1]}
elsif extrema = matrix_extrema_finite(submatrix)
  has_extrema = true
  extrema
else
  {0.0, 1.0}
end

show_cbar = if colorbar.nil?
  (has_extrema && char_height >= 7) && labels
else
  !(!colorbar)
end

fn = colormap_callback(colormap)


data, present = if eff_xfact > 0.0 && eff_yfact > 0.0
  resample_heatmap(z, x_arr, y_arr, eff_xlim, eff_ylim, eff_xfact, eff_yfact, char_height, char_width)
else
  resample_heatmap_unscaled(z_sub, char_height, char_width)
end

area = HeatmapGraphics.new(data, fn, zmin, zmax, !data.empty?, array, present: present)

plot = Plot.new(area, border: border, title: title, xlabel: xlabel, ylabel: ylabel, zlabel: zlabel, margin: margin, padding: padding, labels: labels, compact_labels: compact_labels, compact: compact, unicode_exponent: unicode_exponent, thousands_separator: thousands_separator, colorbar: show_cbar, colorbar_border: colorbar_border, colorbar_lim: {zmin, zmax}, colormap_callback: fn)

if labels
  bc = ansi_color(border_color)
  fmt = ->(v : Float64) do
    nice_repr(v, unicode_exponent, thousands_separator)
  end
  nr = area.nrows

  label_ylim = ylim == {0.0, 0.0} ? eff_ylim : extend_limits(y_arr, eff_ylim)
  label_xlim = xlim == {0.0, 0.0} ? eff_xlim : extend_limits(x_arr, eff_xlim)

  ys_lo = label_ylim[0]
  ys_hi = label_ylim[1]
  xs_lo = label_xlim[0]
  xs_hi = label_xlim[1]


  plot.label!(:bl, fmt.call(xs_lo), bc)
  plot.label!(:br, fmt.call(xs_hi), bc)


  if array
    plot.label!(:l, nr, fmt.call(ys_hi), bc)
    plot.label!(:l, 1, fmt.call(ys_lo), bc)
  else
    plot.label!(:l, nr, fmt.call(ys_lo), bc)
    plot.label!(:l, 1, fmt.call(ys_hi), bc)
  end
end

plot

def.name: print_row
def.body:
if 1 <= row && row <= nrows
else
  raise(ArgumentError.new("`row` out of bounds: #{row}"))
end
idx = row - 1
if @spacer_rows[idx]
  io << (" " * @ncols)
  return
end
bar = @bars[idx]
val = @xscale.call(bar)
nsyms = @symbols.size
frac = @max_val > 0 ? (Math.max(val, 0.0)) / @max_val : 0.0
max_bar_width = Math.max((@ncols - 2) - @max_len, 1)
bar_head = if nsyms > 1
  (frac * max_bar_width).floor.to_i32
else
  (frac * max_bar_width).round(mode: :ties_away).to_i32
end
color = @colors[idx]
UnicodePlot.print_color(io, color, @symbols[nsyms - 1].to_s * bar_head, use_color)
if nsyms > 1
  frac_cells = (frac * max_bar_width) - bar_head
  rem = frac_cells * (nsyms - 2)
  sub_char = if rem <= 0
    ' '
  else
    ri = rem.round.to_i32
    @symbols[ri.clamp(0, nsyms - 2)]
  end
  UnicodePlot.print_color(io, color, sub_char.to_s, use_color)
  bar_head = bar_head + 1
end
bar_lbl = bar >= 0 ? @formatter.call(bar) : ""
len = if bar >= 0
  UnicodePlot.print_color(io, INVALID_COLOR, " #{bar_lbl}", use_color)
  bar_lbl.size
else
  -1
end
pad_len = Math.max((((max_bar_width + 1) + @max_len) - bar_head) - len, 0)
io << (" " * pad_len)

  delta_x = end_x - start_x

  nsteps = Math.min(Math.max(delta_x.abs, delta_y.abs), Int32::MAX.to_f)

    step_y = delta_y / nsteps
    length.times do

      cur_y = cur_y + step_y

delta_y = end_y - start_y

ex, ey = start_x + (last * delta_x), start_y + (last * delta_y)
plot_pixel_if_visible(sx, sy, color, blend, 0.0, @pixel_width.to_f, 0.0, @pixel_height.to_f)

  last_step = Math.min(nsteps.ceil.to_i64, (last * nsteps).ceil.to_i64 + 1)

Render one display row using two data rows packed as half-block characters.
Row 1 = topmost display row. Each display row uses pixel rows 2r-1 and 2r
(adjusted for odd char_height), matching Julia's HeatmapCanvas.print_row.

def.name: print_row
def.body:
char_height = @data.size
if char_height == 0
  return
end


pixel_row = row * 2
if char_height.odd?
  pixel_row = pixel_row - 1
end






lower_p = pixel_row
upper_p = pixel_row - 1

if @yflip
  lower_idx = lower_p - 1
  upper_idx = upper_p > 0 ? upper_p - 1 : -1
else
  lower_idx = char_height - lower_p
  upper_idx = upper_p > 0 ? char_height - upper_p : -1
end

black = UnicodePlot.ansi_color(:black)
(0...@ncols).each do |col|
  lower_row = (lower_idx >= 0 && lower_idx < char_height) ? @data[lower_idx]? : nil
  upper_row = (upper_idx >= 0 && upper_idx < char_height) ? @data[upper_idx]? : nil
  lower_val = lower_row ? lower_row[col]? : nil
  upper_val = upper_row ? upper_row[col]? : nil



  fg = lower_val && @present[lower_idx][col] ? @colormap_fn.call(lower_val, @zmin, @zmax) : black
  bg = if upper_p == 0
    INVALID_COLOR
  elsif upper_val && @present[upper_idx][col]
    @colormap_fn.call(upper_val, @zmin, @zmax)
  else
    black
  end

  if use_color
    if (fg != INVALID_COLOR) && (bg != INVALID_COLOR)
      io << (UnicodePlot.ansi_fg_escape(fg))
      io << (UnicodePlot.ansi_bg_escape(bg))
      (io << HALF_BLOCK) << ANSI_RESET
    elsif fg != INVALID_COLOR
      ((io << (UnicodePlot.ansi_fg_escape(fg))) << HALF_BLOCK) << ANSI_RESET
    elsif bg != INVALID_COLOR
      ((io << (UnicodePlot.ansi_fg_escape(bg))) << '▀') << ANSI_RESET
    else
      io << ' '
    end
  else
    io << ((fg == INVALID_COLOR) && (bg == INVALID_COLOR) ? ' ' : fg == INVALID_COLOR ? '▀' : HALF_BLOCK)
  end
end
